rationale: The browser capture now records the @font-face faces a plain HTML page loads from url() sources (staged files, inline data, and remote https only when the import allows the network), in a font-faces.json sidecar with each rule's descriptors and the bytes Chromium fetched, and the native import binds them into fontFamilyAssets through the same writer as materialized Blob fonts. A used face whose staged file is absent fails as capture-font-missing. No lowering rule or DesignIR schema changes; Chromium stays the oracle for which source loaded. register_font_file routes a WOFF2 file through the existing WOFF2 decoder rather than the platform font manager; the font registry and renderer authority are unchanged.
tests: build/test/pulp-test-font-woff2 "a WOFF2 font file registers through the file path"
